panels.title: Scrape
panels.description: Whether vmagent reaches the metrics endpoint of the volume.

panels.title: Stalled for
panels.description: Seconds since zerofs_total_operations last moved, shown only while mutations are in flight (zerofs_dedup_inflight_ids > 0); 0 when nothing is in flight. Operations are counted on completion, so a growing value means FUSE callers are hanging. Up to about 15 s is scrape lag. MetricsQL (tlast_change_over_time), needs VictoriaMetrics.

panels.title: In-flight mutations
panels.description: zerofs_dedup_inflight_ids: distinct operation ids currently being applied. Non-zero with no completed operations is the stall symptom.

panels.title: Longest stall (range)
panels.description: Maximum of the stall timer over the selected time range.

panels.title: LSM backpressure (range)
panels.description: Writers that had to wait for memtable flush in SlateDB (lsm_db_backpressure_count) plus memtable flushes paused by a full L0 (lsm_db_l0_stall_count) over the selected range. ZeroFS exports SlateDB metrics without their labels, so a labelled SlateDB counter collapses into one series holding the largest label set, not the sum.

panels.title: Resident memory
panels.description: zerofs_jemalloc_resident_bytes.

panels.title: Stall timer
panels.description: Seconds without a completed operation while mutations are in flight. A ramp is a stall, its height is the stall length.

panels.title: In-flight vs completed mutations
panels.description: In-flight operation ids against the rate of completed mutations (zerofs_write_operations_total: write, create, remove, rename, truncate). In flight above zero with the rate at zero is a stall.

panels.title: Logical size
panels.description: zerofs_used_bytes: file bytes as seen through the mount.

panels.title: Stored (live)
panels.description: zerofs_segment_live_bytes: segment bytes still referenced, after compression and encryption.

panels.title: Logical / stored
panels.description: zerofs_used_bytes / zerofs_segment_live_bytes. Effective data reduction; excludes the metadata LSM.

panels.title: Inodes
panels.description: zerofs_used_inodes.

panels.title: Segments
panels.description: zerofs_segment_count: segment objects tracked in the object store.

panels.title: Dead ratio
panels.description: zerofs_segment_dead_ratio: reclaimable bytes / appended bytes. Repacking brings it down.

panels.title: Logical vs stored
panels.description: Logical size, live segment bytes and all bytes held in segments (live + dead).

panels.title: Dead space
panels.description: Reclaimable: appended - live. Awaiting delete: bytes of fully dead segments the last reclaim cycle saw but could not delete yet (delete horizon).

panels.title: Write buffer
panels.description: Raw frame bytes held in RAM and not yet PUT to the object store: the open write buffer plus sealed segments whose upload is in flight. Writers block while this drains. Needs the export-unflushed-bytes patch.

panels.title: Data throughput
panels.description: Logical bytes written and read through the filesystem, and growth of bytes held in segments (compressed; net of segment deletes, clamped at 0).

panels.title: Operations
panels.description: Completed operations. Mutations: write, create, remove, rename, truncate. Reads: read and lookup. Total also counts setattr.

panels.title: Namespace changes
panels.description: Files and directories created, deleted and renamed per second.

panels.title: Process memory
panels.description: jemalloc view of the ZeroFS process and the SlateDB memtable size.

panels.title: L0 and sorted runs
panels.description: L0 SST count is the metadata write backlog waiting for compaction; when it hits the L0 limit memtable flushes pause and writers get backpressure.

panels.title: LSM byte flow
panels.description: Bytes entering memtables, flushed to L0 and rewritten by compaction. Compaction is per worker upstream. ZeroFS exports SlateDB metrics without their labels, so a labelled SlateDB counter collapses into one series holding the largest label set, not the sum.

panels.title: Flushes and compactions
panels.description: Memtable flushes and compaction jobs per interval, and compactions running now. Flushes at zero while writes are in flight means the metadata upload is stuck.

panels.title: Metadata store requests
panels.description: SlateDB object store requests and failures. NOT a failure rate: SlateDB probes for the next manifest and compactions id and gets a routine 404, so errors track requests on a healthy system. ZeroFS exports SlateDB metrics without their labels, so a labelled SlateDB counter collapses into one series holding the largest label set, not the sum. Covers the metadata LSM only, not segment data uploads. Read it as liveness: a flat line while writes are in flight means the backend stopped answering.

panels.title: Reclaim cycles
panels.description: Work done by segment reclaim per interval: cycles run, segments deleted, repack jobs, orphan objects removed.

panels.title: Reclaimed bytes
panels.description: Segment bytes deleted from the object store by reclaim.

panels.title: Reclaim in flight
panels.description: Reclaim executor activity right now and the number of dead segments waiting for the delete horizon.

panels.title: Tombstone backlog
panels.description: Deleted files whose extents are not cleaned up yet: tombstones created - processed. Both counters reset when the service restarts.

panels.title: Tombstone cleanup
panels.description: Extents removed by the tombstone cleaner per second.
